title: EUREKA (REEL MAKING)
rounds: 2 Rounds (Round 1: Pre-Event Promo Reel | Round 2: On-Spot Event Day Highlights Reel)
rules:
General Technical & Aspect Ratio Guidelines:

  • Aspect Ratio Mandatory Rule: All video entries for both rounds MUST be shot and submitted in Portrait Ratio (9:16 vertical orientation). Landscape (16:9) videos will be penalized or disqualified.
  • Team Composition: Each team must consist of 2 to 3 participants belonging to the same Higher Secondary School.
  • Content Standards: All content must be original. Plagiarism, inappropriate themes, or copyright violations will result in immediate disqualification.

Round 1: Pre-Event Promotional Reel

  • Topic / Objective: Promoting BitBuzz 8.0, creating hype, and building anticipation for the main event day.
  • Video Duration: 45 to 60 seconds
  • Posting & Social Engagement: Teams must post the Reel publicly on Instagram prior to the event, tag the official college handle, and use official hashtags.
  • On-Day File Submission (Mandatory): In addition to posting online, teams MUST submit the raw original video file in MP4 format on the day of the event (via Google Drive or Pen Drive) to the event coordinators.

Round 2: On-Spot Event Highlights Reel

  • Topic / Objective: Capturing the live essence, energy, and key moments of BitBuzz 8.0 from the Inauguration Ceremony up to the Afternoon Break.
  • Video Duration: 60 to 90 seconds
  • Submission Policy: The Round 2 Reel must NOT be posted online on Instagram. Teams must submit the final edited video file in MP4 format directly to the event coordinators at the designated deadline on the event day.
